description: Returns the tasks of a poker game with their estimate, individual votes, tracker key and link. needs_sync tells whether the agreed estimate still differs from the one stored in the tracker — feed those tasks to poker.game.task.sync. Filter with estimated to see what is done or what is left.

estimated.description: true — only tasks that already have an estimate, false — only tasks still to be estimated. Omit for all of them.

game_id.description: The ID of the poker game.

limit.description: How many tasks to return. Default: 50, maximum: 100.

name: poker.game.tasks.list
title: List Poker Tasks Tool
